summary.text: Chris Phillips is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 68, where he has served since 2018, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is the president of CGP Foods, Inc.

paragraphs.text: Chris Phillips was born in Buckhannon, West Virginia, and graduated from Philip Barbour High School.
His career experience includes working as the president of CGP Foods, Inc.
Ballotpedia lists him as a volunteer member of the National Rifle Association and the West Virginia Citizens Defense League.
Phillips has served in the House of Delegates since 2018 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
